P.name: Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kled''' rides his semi-trusty mount, '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}'''. While {{sbc|Mounted}}, all damage dealt to the duo is suffered by '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''', who has {{pplevel|color=health|{{#expr:{{ccd|Kled & Skaarl|hp_base}}-{{ccd|Kled|hp_base}}}}+{{#expr:{{ccd|Kled & Skaarl|hp_lvl}}-{{ccd|Kled|hp_lvl}}}}*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))|formula={{#expr:{{ccd|Kled & Skaarl|hp_base}}-{{ccd|Kled|hp_base}}}}+{{#expr:({{ccd|Kled & Skaarl|hp_lvl}}-{{ccd|Kled|hp_lvl}})*17 round 1}}/17*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))}} {{as|'''base''' health}}; additional sources of health are applied to '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{as|'''maximum''' health}}. Effects based on percentage health consider '''Kled''' and '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' combined {{as|'''maximum''' health}}.
P.description2: Being reduced below {{as|{{sti|health|0 health}}}} causes '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' to flee, forcing '''Kled''' to be {{sbc|Dismounted}}, with all damage in excess of '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health being ignored. Upon dismounting, '''Kled''' {{tip|lunge|lunges}} in the direction of the allied [[Nexus]], though {{tt|not through terrain|see notes}}, while {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} himself of all {{tip|crowd control}} and becoming {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. {{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|''Dismounting''}} resets the {{sti|cooldown}} and charges of ''{{ai|Pocket Pistol|Kled}}''.
P.description3: While '''Kled''' is {{sbc|Dismounted}}, his {{as|'''base''' health}} and {{as|movement speed}} are reduced; however, he gains {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} while moving toward enemy champions. Additionally, he gains {{sti|attack range|'''bonus''' attack range}}, and his attacks deal {{pp|85 to 100 for 4|1;6;11;16|key=%}} damage to champions. ''{{ai|Bear Trap on a Rope|Kled}}'' is replaced with ''{{ai|Pocket Pistol|Kled}}'', while ''{{ai|Jousting|Kled}}'' and ''{{ai|Chaaaaaaaarge!!!|Kled}}'' become unusable.
P.description4: While {{sbc|Mounted}}, {{tip|heal|healing}} and {{as|{{sti|health regeneration}}}} will first replenish '''{{uis|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' health and will only apply to '''Kled's''' health while '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' is at ''full'' health.
P.description5: ''For more details, check the {{sbc|Dismounted}} part of the ability.''

Q.name: Bear Trap on a Rope
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kled''' throws a bear trap in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, increased to 150% against {{tip|minion|minions}}, small {{tip|pet|pets}}, and small and medium {{tip|monsters}}. The bear trap collides with the first enemy {{tip|champion}}, large pet, or large monster hit, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, and forming a {{tip|tether}} between '''Kled''' and the target for {{fd|1.75}} seconds.
Q.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30 to 130}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Minion and Small Monster Damage|{{ap|30*1.5 to 130*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:60*1.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description2: The tether's radius shrinks over its duration, and if it is not broken before then, '''Kled''' {{tip|airborne|pulls}} the target {{tt|150|Estimated}} units toward him, deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
Q.leveling2:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|30*2 to 130*2}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:60*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|30*3 to 130*3}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:60*3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|30 to 50}}%}}
Q.description3: ''Bear Trap on a Rope can be cast while {{ai|Jousting|Kled}}.''

W.name: Violent Tendencies
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Kled''' periodically gains ''Violent Tendencies'', which starts expiring upon his next {{tip|basic attack}}.
W.description2:
{{sbc|Violent Tendencies:}} '''Kled''' gains {{sti|attack speed|{{as|150% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} on his next 4 basic attacks within 4 seconds. The fourth attack is empowered to deal {{as|'''additional''' physical damage}}. The damage based on the target's health is capped at 200 against {{tip|monsters}}.

''Violent Tendencies' '' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds {{tip|on-hit}}, increased to {{fd|1.5}} against champions.
W.leveling2: {{st|Additional Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4.5 to 6.5}}% {{as|(+ 2% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.4}}% per 100 '''bonus''' health)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
W.description3: Against {{tip|structures}}, the fourth attack deals modified {{as|'''additional''' physical damage}}.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Structure Additional Damage|{{pplevel|62+1.75*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1))|formula=62 + 1.75 * (level - 1) * (0.7025 + 0.0175 * (level - 1)) (aka growth formula)}} (+ {{ap|0 to 60}})}}<!--
Not affected by bonus AD, not dependent on tower HP (unless there's a cap but it's really low), ranking up adds 15 damage flat, leveling up the champion adds damage similar to the stat gain per level formula (still works for level 19, 20) -->
W.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|13 to 9}}|Starts after the attacks time out or are consumed}}

E.name: Jousting
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, though not through terrain, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through and {{tip|airborne|pulling}} {{tip|minion|minions}}, {{tip|pet|pets}}, and small and medium {{tip|monster|monsters}} hit towards her.
E.description2: Upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large monster, '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|dashes}} a fixed 350 units through them, marking them for 3 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}. After the dash ends, the duo gain {{sti|ms|{{as|50% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 1 second. ''Jousting'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the first dash ending while the target is marked.
E.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' consumes the mark to {{tip|dash}} through the marked target, applying the same effects as the first cast though being able to dash through terrain.
E.description4: The mark will remain even if the target dies, and ends prematurely if the duo are too far away or '''Kled''' ''{{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounts}}''.
E.description5: ''{{ai|Bear Trap on a Rope|Kled}} and {{ai|Chaaaaaaaarge!!!|Kled}} can be cast during either of the dashes.''

R.name: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kled''' & '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' charge toward the target location, automatically navigating terrain along the way, during which they are {{tip|ghosted}}, {{tip|Cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} to enemy {{tip|champion|champions}} in a {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|1250|estimated}} radius. If the charge does not complete within 15 seconds, it will end prematurely. The charge is interrupted instantly if '''Kled''' ''{{ai|Dismounted Skaarl the Cowardly Lizard|Kled|dismounts}}'' during it.
R.description2: While charging, the duo gain an initial {{tip|shield}}, plus an additional amount for every {{fd|0.25}} seconds of traveling, up to a cap at 2 seconds. The shield lasts for 2 seconds upon finishing the charge. Additionally, the duo trails a directional draft in their wake, lasting 9 seconds. Allied units other than lane {{tip|minions}} following the draft gain ''Mr. Kled's Wild Ride''. After {{fd|0.5}} seconds of charging, the duo gain {{tt|{{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds|see notes}}, up to {{tt|{{as|950 '''total''' movement speed|ms}}|after movement speed soft caps}} over 3 seconds.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Total Shield|{{ap|20*10 to 40*10}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:30*10}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Initial Shield|{{ap|20*2 to 40*2}} {{as|(+ {{#expr:30*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Shield Per Instance|{{ap|20 to 40}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description3: {{sbc|Mr. Kled's Wild Ride:}} While in [[combat status|champion combat]], gain {{sti|ms|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. After not being in champion combat for 3 seconds, if '''Kled''' is charging, gain {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} up to {{as|'''Kled's current''' movement speed}}; otherwise gain up to {{tt|{{as|650 '''total''' movement speed|ms}}|after movement speed soft caps}}.
R.description4: '''Kled''' & '''{{ui|Skaarl|nolink=true}}''' will {{tip|dash}} toward the first {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champion {{tt|in range of the charge|see notes}}, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} the target during the dash and colliding with the first visible enemy champion in their path to deal {{as|magic damage}}, increased by {{pp|type=charge time|key=%|label=Damage Increase|0 to 200 for 26|0 to 4|formula=8% increase per 0.16 seconds. ''This is capped at 4 seconds of time active.''}}, {{tip|airborne|knock them back}} 150 units, though {{tt|not through terrain|see notes}}, and end the charge.
R.leveling4: {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|4 to 8}}% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{as|{{ap|4*3 to 8*3}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|3*3}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
